question: Should the system-ontology owner admit this exact deterministic D65-S5 graph and system-runtime ontology candidate?

options.label: Admit exact D65-S5 system ontology
options.effect: Admit only the exact compiled graph and system-runtime ontology candidate, pass G-D65-COMPILE, and make D65-S6 exact implementation-binding authorship eligible under its separate mandatory delegation and owner gate.
options.benefit: Establishes one immutable compiler-derived runtime model with closed graph, provenance, event calculus, and subject projection contracts.
options.cost_or_risk: Freezes this exact compiler and output epoch as the predecessor for the next binding; later semantic change requires a new source and compilation epoch.
does_not_authorize: publication, release, deployment, credentials, destructive action, or external effects

options.label: Amend before admission
options.effect: Return the exact candidate for one bounded owner-specified amendment while G-D65-COMPILE remains blocked.
options.benefit: Corrects a concrete model or evidence defect before downstream binding depends on it.
options.cost_or_risk: Requires recompilation, fresh byte-identity evidence, hostile checks, and a new exact owner request.

options.label: Defer admission
options.effect: Preserve the validated candidate and evidence without making D65-S6 eligible.
options.benefit: Keeps the candidate reviewable while avoiding downstream commitment.
options.cost_or_risk: The event-sourced ontology integration remains blocked before exact implementation binding.

options.label: Stop the D65 route
options.effect: Reject this candidate as the route forward and stop the current D65 chain pending new owner direction.
options.benefit: Avoids carrying forward a model the owner does not consider suitable.
options.cost_or_risk: Requires a new route or source epoch to resume the integration.

recommendation: D65SYS-1, because the candidate is a pure derivation of the admitted D65-S4 source, both internal and external double compilation pass, graph/provenance/event-calculus closure passes, and hostile mutations fail closed.
claim_ceiling: This request presents a validated candidate only. It does not admit the system ontology, accept an implementation binding, implement, migrate, cut over, publish, release, deploy, or create external effects.
